raw:
Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 11
Reason for Mistake: Instead of retrieving the exact edit count up to June 2023 using Wikipedia’s revision history/XTools date filters, WebSurfer approximated by averaging edits per year and assuming a uniform distribution, then presented the estimate (2,619) as the final answer. This methodological shortcut ignored the time-bounded requirement and available tools for a precise count, leading to an incorrect solution and premature task completion.
